title: Giving a status update
intro: On a client call, a good status update is short: where you are, what's next, and any risks.
introNative: Client call पर अच्छा status update short होता है: अभी आप कहाँ हैं, आगे क्या है, और कोई risk।

phrases.text: We're on track to deliver by Friday.
phrases.native: हम शुक्रवार तक deliver करने के लिए on track हैं।
phrases.note: "On track" means everything is going to plan.

phrases.text: We've completed about 80% of the testing.
phrases.native: हमने लगभग 80% testing complete कर ली है।
phrases.note: Use "we've completed" for progress up to now.

phrases.text: The next milestone is the UAT release on the 15th.
phrases.native: अगला milestone 15 तारीख को UAT release है।
phrases.note: A milestone is an important checkpoint in the plan.

phrases.text: There's one risk I'd like to flag.
phrases.native: एक risk है जिसे मैं flag करना चाहूँगा।
phrases.note: "Flag" means point out early, so nobody is surprised later.

phrases.text: I'll share a written update after the call.
phrases.native: Call के बाद मैं एक written update share करूँगा।
phrases.note: Clients like a short written summary after a call.

steps.prompt: The client asks: "How's the project going?" Which reply sounds most professional?
steps.promptNative: Client पूछते हैं: "Project कैसा चल रहा है?" कौन-सा जवाब सबसे professional लगता है?
options: Project is fine only.
We're on track to deliver by Friday.
Everything is going on, no problem.
steps.answer: We're on track to deliver by Friday.
steps.explanation: Give a clear status and a date, not just "fine".
steps.explanationNative: सिर्फ़ "fine" नहीं, साफ़ status और एक date बताइए।

steps.promptNative: हमने लगभग 80% testing complete कर ली है।
steps.answer: We've completed about 80% of the testing.

steps.audioText: The next milestone is the UAT release on the 15th.
options: The next milestone is the UAT release on the 15th.
The next meeting is about the UAT release on the 15th.
The last milestone was the UAT release on the 5th.
steps.answer: The next milestone is the UAT release on the 15th.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: We have completed the testing yesterday.
options: We have completed the testing yesterday.
We completed the testing yesterday.
We are completing the testing yesterday.
We had completed the testing yesterday only.
steps.explanation: With a finished time like "yesterday", use the simple past: "completed", not "have completed".
steps.explanationNative: "Yesterday" जैसे बीत चुके समय के साथ simple past इस्तेमाल करें: "completed" कहें, "have completed" नहीं।

steps.prompt: You want to warn the client early about a possible delay. What do you say?
steps.promptNative: आप client को संभावित delay के बारे में पहले से warn करना चाहते हैं। आप क्या कहेंगे?
options: There is one big problem coming.
There's one risk I'd like to flag.
I have one doubt about delay.
steps.answer: There's one risk I'd like to flag.
steps.explanation: "Flag a risk" sounds calm and in control.
steps.explanationNative: "Flag a risk" शांत लगता है और दिखाता है कि situation आपके control में है।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I have one doubt about the timeline.
options: I have one doubt about the timeline.
I have a question about the timeline.
I am having one doubt about the timeline.
I have a doubt regarding the timeline.
steps.answer: I have a question about the timeline.
steps.explanation: In international English, "doubt" means you think something may not be true. To ask something, say "I have a question".
steps.explanationNative: International English में "doubt" का मतलब है कि आपको लगता है कोई बात शायद सच नहीं है। कुछ पूछना हो तो "I have a question" कहें।

steps.promptNative: Call के बाद मैं एक written update share करूँगा।
steps.answer: I'll share a written update after the call.

steps.audioText: There's one risk I'd like to flag.
options: There's one risk I'd like to flag.
There's one task I'd like to add.
There was one risk I didn't flag.
steps.answer: There's one risk I'd like to flag.

steps.prompt: Give a 3-sentence status update on your real project, out loud: where you are, what's next, and one risk.
steps.promptNative: अपने असली project पर 3 sentences का status update बोलकर दीजिए: अभी आप कहाँ हैं, आगे क्या है, और एक risk।
